camel_example: aliyun dts DescribeSynchronizationJobs --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key testkey1 --AccountId 123233440000 --PageSize 30 --PageNum 1 --SynchronizationJobName 'MySQL同步' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-acfmzawhxxc0000' --Tag.1.Value testvalue1 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --ClientToken '0c593ea1-3bea-11e9-b96b-88e9fe630000'
description_en: Queries a list of data synchronization instances and the details of each instance by calling DescribeSynchronizationJobs
description_zh: 通过DescribeSynchronizationJobs查询数据同步实例列表和各同步实例的详情
kebab_example: aliyun dts describe-synchronization-jobs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-size 30 --page-num 1 --synchronization-job-name 'MySQL同步' --client-token 0c593ea1-3bea-11e9-b96b-88e9fe630000 --account-id 123233440000 --tag Value=testvalue1 Key=testkey1 --resource-group-id rg-acfmzawhxxc0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSynchronizationJobs

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the data synchronization instance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.help_zh: 数据同步实例所在地域的ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141033.html
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of records per page. Valid values: 10, 20, and 30. Default value: 30. Maximum value: 30
parameters.help_zh: 每页记录数。取值为： 10、20、30，默认值为30，最大值为30
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The page number. The value must be an integer greater than 0 and must not exceed the maximum value of the Integer data type. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，取值为大于0且不超过Integer数据类型的最大值，默认值为1
parameters.name: page_num

parameters.help_en:
The name of the synchronization instance.
Fuzzy match is supported
parameters.help_zh:
同步实例名称。
支持模糊查询
parameters.name: synchronization_job_name

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The ClientToken parameter can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account. You do not need to specify this parameter because it will be discontinued
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云主账号ID，无需设置，该参数即将下线
parameters.name: account_id

element_fields.help_en:
The tag key. You can query tag keys by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/191187.html operation.
N specifies the sequence number of the tag key. For example, Tag.1.Key specifies the key of the first tag, and Tag.2.Key specifies the key of the second tag. You can specify 1 to 20 tag keys at a time.
This parameter cannot be set to an empty string
element_fields.help_zh:
标签键，可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/191187.html接口查询。
N表示第几个标签的键。例如：Tag.1.Key表示第一个标签的键；Tag.2.Key表示第二个标签的键。可以同时传入1~20个标签键。
该参数传入时不允许传入空字符串
element_fields.name: key

element_fields.help_en:
The tag value. You can query tag values by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/191187.html operation.
N specifies the sequence number of the tag value. For example, Tag.1.Value specifies the value of the first tag, and Tag.2.Value specifies the value of the second tag. You can specify 1 to 20 tag values at a time.
This parameter can be set to an empty string
element_fields.help_zh:
标签的值，可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/191187.html接口查询。
N表示第几个标签的值。例如：Tag.1.Value表示第一个标签的值；Tag.2.Value表示第二个标签的值。可以同时传入1~20个标签值。
允许传入空字符串
element_fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The tags of the data synchronization instance. The tags are used as filter conditions. If you specify this parameter, only instances that have the specified tags are returned
parameters.help_zh: 数据同步实例的标签，作为过滤项，当此项不为空时，仅拥有此标签的实例任务会返回
parameters.name: tag
